sect1.title: Consequences
sect1.para: When a new group is formed a group internal flag will be assigned to each node, constraint point and element. There are two group-internal object flags, PLAIN and BOUNDARY. When a new group is formed, the Region method IdentifyBoundaryAs() assigns the group-internal object flags, depending on whether the nodes, constraint points or elements in the group lie at the group boundary or inside of the group. Elements are assigned a boundary flag if at least one of their faces coincides with the region boundary.
